description: Put ONE match on the venue call screen FOR ITS COURT — every court has its own screen with its own link, and the screen_url this tool returns is that court's link (open one display per court). The court's screen immediately shows the court number huge with both player names, and keeps showing it until cleared; other courts' screens are unaffected. Use on match day when a specific match must be called out on the big screen. Needs the tournament's manage_code. This is an independent on-screen slot: it does NOT change the console calling queue — the queue board (or the standby face) comes back on that display when you clear with screen_clear. Takes effect immediately, no preview step.

court.description: Court label as shown, e.g. '3' or 'Center'

note.description: Optional line shown with the match, e.g. 'Semifinal' or 'Final'

player_a.description: First player / side name, exactly as it should appear on the big screen

player_b.description: Second player / side name, exactly as it should appear on the big screen

name: screen_show
